children: NightFood entered a global lock-up with note holders restricting conversions and warrant exercises through January 17, 2027.
NightFood and note holders Mast Hill Fund and Pacific Pier agreed a Lock-Up effective Oct 20, 2026.
Lock-Up bars conversion of convertible notes and exercise of related warrants from Oct 20, 2026 to Jan 17, 2027.
Company may, at its sole discretion, grant irrevocable written permission to convert or exercise during the Lock-Up.
Agreements filed as Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2 to the Form 8-K; summary is qualified by the full agreements.
